About Us

Experienced leaders. Practical support.

PHM Consulting stands for Planning, High Performance and Momentum. We work with leaders who need to improve how their organizations operate while continuing to deliver every day.

Our experience spans organizational leadership, governance, strategic planning, project delivery and operational improvement. We help you identify what matters most, involve the right people and develop improvements your organization can put into practice.

We help you understand what's holding your organization back, turn strategy into action and strengthen how your team works together. Each engagement is scoped around your priorities, capacity and intended outcomes.

01

Organizational Performance

A focused assessment of an agreed organizational area, which may include strategy, governance, workflows, reporting or project oversight. We review relevant information and speak with key people to identify strengths, gaps and barriers.

What you receive
  • A diagnostic assessment of strengths, gaps and barriers.
  • Prioritized improvement recommendations.
  • A 90-day roadmap with proposed owners, milestones and measures.

Typical timeframe: 3–5 weeks, depending on scope. The scope is agreed before work begins. Implementation support is available as a separate engagement.

Discuss an Assessment
3–5 weeks90-day roadmap
02

Strategy to Execution

We help leaders translate organizational goals into manageable initiatives, clear responsibilities and a practical approach to tracking delivery.

Support may include
  • An implementation plan with priorities and milestones.
  • Defined roles, responsibilities and decision points.
  • Progress reporting and review routines.
  • Identification of delivery risks and resource needs.
Discuss Your Priorities
03

Leadership Effectiveness

We help leadership teams clarify expectations, improve governance and establish practical ways to lead through competing demands.

Support may include
  • Clarification of leadership roles and decision authority.
  • Governance and meeting effectiveness reviews.
  • Facilitated leadership discussions and working sessions.
  • Change leadership and communication planning.
Discuss Leadership Support
04

Culture and Employee Engagement

We help organizations identify what supports or undermines engagement, then work with leaders and employees to develop practical improvements.

Support may include
  • Employee listening sessions or engagement surveys.
  • An assessment of recurring themes and improvement opportunities.
  • Facilitated team workshops.
  • An action plan with responsibilities and follow-up measures.
